verdict.summary: The change correctly centralizes fail-closed rejection of SPARQL dataset clauses and applies it to all four query-text fragment gates. `recheck` inherits the rejection through `fragment_patterns`, while the existing wave-1 behavior is preserved through the same helper. The added test covers FROM, FROM NAMED, mixed clauses, SELECT/ASK, every affected public entry point, the indirect recheck path, the shared rejection reason, and a dataset-free control. The documentation accurately explains the consumer-honesty issue and retains the required research-grade/external-audit caveat. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect was found.
